name: College Costs: Netwren

shortDescription: College Costs: Netwren teaches how college is really paid for, with three working tools, real public data and short lessons for students and families.
longDescription:
College Costs: Netwren teaches how college is really paid for, with three working tools, real public data and short lessons for students and families.

### Twelve Short Units
Sticker price vs net price; how grants, loans and work-study work; FAFSA and CSS Profile in principle; scholarships; comparing aid offers; loans and repayment; budgeting; community college and transfer; graduating with less debt; work and internships; taxes and aid; and spotting scholarship scams. Each unit has a story, a try-it, a build-it, and a check-it quiz. Choose Beginner, Curious or Scientist depth.

### Three Tools
- Net price planner: enter costs and aid, run what-if scenarios (commute, merit award not renewed, tuition rising) and see the gap year by year.
- Aid-offer comparer: put two to four offers side by side on equal terms and see net price, borrowing and repayment.
- Loan simulator: see balance, monthly payment, interest and payoff with typeset amortisation formulas.

### Real Data, Cited
Look up cost and outcome numbers for more than 2,300 colleges from the U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard (file dated 2026-11-02). Every source opens in a sheet inside the app with its access date.

### Practice
240 original questions with reasons, a daily challenge, streaks and badges. A- and A+ buttons scale all text from 50% to 300%. Works offline. No account needed.
